_comment: A detached JWS over the Agent Card, A2A §8.4. The payload is the card with `signatures` excluded, canonicalised per RFC 8785 — it is not carried here, because the card itself is the payload. Produced by `node tools/sign-card.mjs`, never by the build: ECDSA is randomised, so a build that signed would not be byte-identical to the previous one. build-site.mjs and launch-gate.mjs only verify.
_payload_sha256_comment: sha256 of the canonical payload this signature was made over. The build refuses when the card's current canonical payload hashes differently, which is what turns 'someone edited the card and forgot to re-sign' from a silent stale signature into a refused build.
